title: Data splitting
prompt:
Create reproducible training and test sets.

Deliverable: submit a small local Python script/notebook or concise reproducible technical report. Include the code or exact configuration, the output/metric you observed, and one limitation. The existing grader only checks required strings; it does not execute Python, so technical correctness still needs human review. Use synthetic or permitted data only.

starter.starter:
# Exercise 3: Data splitting
# Implement locally or write a reproducible report.
# Task: Create reproducible training and test sets.
# Evidence and limitation: add your notes below.

public_tests.name: Required evidence present
public_tests.note: The server-side keyword grader is only a basic submission gate and does not execute learner code.

acceptance_criteria: Address the objective: Create reproducible training and test sets.
Provide evidence for the expected outcome: Understand holdout evaluation.
Use a reproducible setup and clearly state at least one assumption or limitation.
hints: Start with the smallest synthetic or built-in dataset and inspect its shape, types, and target.
Use a baseline and an evaluation approach that matches the task; do not tune against the final test set.
Run the workflow locally, record versions/output, and check the result rather than relying only on keyword matches.

retry_policy.guidance: Revise the submission using the hints. The platform grants exercise XP only after a correct, server-graded submission and only once per activity; the keyword grader is a submission gate, not proof of technical quality.
